title: Accelerating high-throughput catalyst screening by direct generation of equilibrium adsorption structures
title_zh: 通过直接生成平衡吸附结构加速高通量催化剂筛选
summary: 作者开发了 DBCata，这是一种在没有能量或力标签的情况下训练的生成模型，可产生接近平衡的吸附结构，从而能够更快地筛选候选催化剂。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 21 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79243-9 The authors develop DBCata, a generative model trained without energy or force labels to produce near-equilibrium adsorption structures, enabling faster screening of candidate catalysts.

title: Simulation-Guided Optimization of Cigs Heterojunction Solar Cells for Through-Fire Imaging as Calibrated Photodetectors
title_zh: 模拟引导优化 Cigs 异质结太阳能电池作为校准光电探测器进行直射成像
summary: 本研究评估了铜铟镓硒 (CIGS) 异质结光电探测器在光吸收、湍流引起的模糊和传感器噪声下透过火焰成像的可行性。 SCAPS-1D 器件模拟改变了吸收体掺杂浓度、界面陷阱密度和复合参数，以获得电流密度-电压 (J-V) 特性和量子效率，由此计算光谱响应度、噪声等效功率 (NEP) 和比探测率 (D*)。开发了包含这些退化的图像形成模型来评估成像性能。
abstract: This study assesses the feasibility of copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS) heterojunction photodetectors for imaging through fire under optical absorption, turbulence-induced blur, and sensor noise. SCAPS-1D device simulations varied the absorber doping concentration, interface trap density, and recombination parameters to obtain the current density–voltage (J–V) characteristics and quantum efficiency, from which the spectral responsivity, noise-equivalent power (NEP), and specific detectivity (D*) were calculated. An image formation model incorporating these degradations was developed to evaluate imaging performance. Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) and wavelet-based filtering were compared using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and fire/no-fire classification was performed with histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) features and a linear support vector machine (SVM). Increasing the acceptor concentration raised the simulated efficiency from 16.66% to 21.75%. At 808 nm, the photodetector achieved a responsivity of 0.652 A/W and an NEP of 2.16 × 10⁻¹⁴ W·Hz− 1/2. Wavelet-based enhancement increased the mean SSIM from 0.321 to 0.733, and the classifier achieved approximately 82% accuracy and 90% fire-class recall. These simulation results indicate the potential of combining CIGS photodetector design with image restoration and machine learning for through-fire imaging.

title: Entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity enables near-decoupled polarization–strain behavior for high-density energy storage
title_zh: 熵工程设计的极性异质性可实现高密度储能的近解耦极化应变行为
summary: 强极化-应变耦合限制了无铅介电电容器的能量密度和可靠性。在这里，作者表明，熵工程的极性异质性削弱了这种耦合，从而以最小的静电应变实现超高能量存储。
abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 21 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79625-z Strong polarization–strain coupling limits the energy density and reliability of lead-free dielectric capacitors. Here, the authors show that entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity weakens this coupling, enabling ultrahigh energy storage with minimal electrostrain.

title: Annealing-Induced Nanosheet Formation in Sputtered VOx for High-Performance NH3 Sensing
title_zh: 溅射 VOx 中退火诱导的纳米片形成，用于高性能 NH3 传感
summary: 本研究介绍了通过反应直流磁控溅射沉积的 VOx 薄膜氨 (NH3) 气体传感器的制造和优化，然后在 100–550°C 的温度范围内进行系统的后退火。建立了退火温度、相组成、薄膜形态和 NH3 传感响应之间的系统相关性。 X 射线衍射分析揭示了从非晶结构到高度结晶、优先取向的斜方 V2O5 相的转变，在 480°C 及以上的退火温度下获得了接近纯相的高度结晶结构。 FESEM 观察结果表明，形态发生了显着的演变，最终在 480°C 下形成了多孔纳米片状结构。
abstract: This study presents the fabrication and optimization of VOx thin-film Ammonia (NH3) gas sensors deposited by reactive DC magnetron sputtering, followed by systematic post-annealing in the temperature range of 100–550°C. Systematic correlations between annealing temperature, phase composition, film morphology, and NH3 sensing response were established. X-ray diffraction analysis revealed a transition from an amorphous structure to a highly crystalline, preferentially oriented orthorhombic V2O5 phase, with the nearly phase-pure, highly crystalline structure obtained at annealing temperatures of 480°C and above. FESEM observations demonstrated significant morphological evolution, culminating in the formation of porous nanosheet-like structures at 480°C. Such a morphology is expected to expose more accessible surface sites and facilitate NH3 diffusion, thereby contributing to the enhanced sensing performance. Gas sensing measurements toward NH3 showed a strong dependence on annealing temperature, with each sensor exhibiting a distinct optimum operating temperature governed by adsorption–desorption and surface reaction kinetics. Among all samples, the 480°C annealed sensor exhibited the best performance, achieving a maximum sensitivity of 104% toward 50 ppm NH3 at an operating temperature of 207°C, along with fast response–recovery behavior and excellent stability. The enhanced sensing performance is attributed primarily to the optimized crystallinity, reduced lattice microstrain, and porous nanosheet morphology achieved at the 480°C annealing condition. Literature-reported V5+/V4+ mediated surface redox processes in V2O5 may also contribute to the observed NH3 response. The 460°C annealed sensor additionally achieves sensitivities of 42% at 67°C, indicating viable low-power operating conditions. Overall, this work demonstrates that controlled post-annealing is a key strategy for tuning VOx thin-film properties and provides a simple, scalable, and cost-effective approach for the development of high-performance NH3 gas sensors.

title: Composite solid surface parabolic reflector of spacecraft mirror antenna: design and testing
title_zh: 航天器镜面天线复合固体表面抛物面反射器：设计与测试
summary: 本文提出了一种用于航天器镜面天线的复合超轻固体表面反射器的新颖设计。反射器包括反射壳和支撑壳，两者共享抛物线形状并在孔边缘处接合。这种构造形成了提供很大刚性的封闭结构。通过参数化有限元模态分析，设计、制作并测试了孔径直径为0.6 m、焦距为0.15 m的抛物面反射镜物理样机。开发了一种制造技术，以确保反射壳几何形状与理想抛物面的偏差最小。反射器经过了振动和热测试，证实复合材料设计能够承受航天器注入地球轨道和随后绕轨道运行期间所经历的机械和热载荷。
abstract: This paper presents a novel design for a composite ultralightweight solid surface reflector intended for spacecraft mirror antennas. The reflector comprises reflecting and supporting shells, both sharing a parabolic shape and joined at the aperture edges. This configuration forms a closed structure that provides substantial rigidity. Through parametric finite element modal analysis, a physical prototype of the parabolic reflector with an aperture diameter of 0.6 m and a focal distance of 0.15 m was designed, manufactured, and tested. A fabrication technology was developed to ensure minimal deviations of the reflective shell geometry from the ideal paraboloid. The reflector underwent vibration and thermal testing, which confirmed that the composite design can withstand the mechanical and thermal loads experienced during spacecraft injection into Earth’s orbit and subsequent orbiting. The resulting composite parabolic reflector is ultralightweight and meets all necessary requirements for generating narrowly directed electromagnetic radiation at high frequencies.

title: Efficient Degradation of Rhodamine B by g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl Composite Photocatalyst Adsorption under Visible-Light Irradiation
title_zh: 可见光照射下g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合光催化剂吸附高效降解罗丹明B
summary: 本研究首先通过溶剂热法合成了CaCO3/BiOCl，然后在磁力搅拌下与g-C3N4结合制备了g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料。分别通过 XRD、SEM、FT-IR 和 UV-Vis DRS 对样品的相结构、形貌、官能团和光吸收性能进行了表征。在 300 W 氙灯照射下，以 RhB 作为模型污染物。 RhB对g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl复合材料的光催化降解效率在60分钟内达到98.81%，分别约为纯BiOCl和CaCO3/BiOCl的2.49倍和1.38倍。
abstract: In this study, CaCO3/BiOCl was first synthesized via a solvothermal method, and subsequently combined with g-C3N4 under magnetic stirring to fabricate g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite materials. The phase structure, morphology, functional groups, and optical absorption properties of the samples were characterized by XRD, SEM, FT-IR, and UV-Vis DRS, respectively. Under irradiation from a 300 W Xe lamp, with RhB as the model pollutant. The photocatalytic degradation efficiency of RhB over the g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite reached 98.81% within 60min, which is approximately 2.49 times and 1.38 times that of pure BiOCl and CaCO3/BiOCl, respectively. After five consecutive cycling tests, the degradation efficiency still remained above 95%, demonstrating excellent photocatalytic stability. UV-Vis diffuse reflectance spectra (DRS) and Tauc Polt revealed that the composite photocatalyst possesses a narrow bandgap of 2.5 eV, indicative of enhanced visible-light absorption. Meanwhile, PL, TPC, and EIS confirmed the efficient separation of photogenerated electron-hole pairs. The combined effects of broadened light absorption and suppressed charge recombination, contributed to the significantly enhanced photocatalytic performance. Results suggest that the g-C3N4/CaCO3/BiOCl composite material exhibits promising potential for application in photocatalytic degradation of wastewater pollutants.

title: Magnetic-Field-Assisted Hydrothermal Synthesis of Rod-Like Fe 3 O 4 : Morphology Evolution and Magnetic Retention under Flow
title_zh: 磁场辅助水热合成棒状 Fe 3 O 4 ：流动下的形貌演化和磁保留
summary: 外部磁场可以影响磁性纳米晶体的各向异性生长；然而，场诱导形态与流动下磁保留之间的关系仍不清楚。在这项研究中，Fe3O4 是在 0.36 T 磁场（F-Fe3O4）和其他相同的零场条件（Z-Fe3O4）下水热合成的。研究了 NaOH 用量、反应时间和温度对产物形成的影响，并对所得样品的晶体结构、形貌和磁性能进行了表征。两个样品都保留了磁铁矿晶体结构。 F-Fe3O4呈棒状形貌，长度约为75 nm，宽度约为25 nm。
abstract: An external magnetic field can influence the anisotropic growth of magnetic nanocrystals; however, the relationship between field-induced morphology and magnetic retention under flow remains insufficiently understood. In this study, Fe3O4 was synthesized hydrothermally under a magnetic field of 0.36 T (F-Fe3O4) and under otherwise identical zero-field conditions (Z-Fe3O4). The effects of NaOH dosage, reaction time, and temperature on product formation were investigated, and the resulting samples were characterized in terms of crystal structure, morphology, and magnetic properties. Both samples retained the magnetite crystal structure. F-Fe3O4 exhibited a rod-like morphology, with a length of approximately 75 nm and a width of approximately 25 nm. HRTEM analysis indicated that F-Fe3O4 grew along the easy magnetization axis [110]. In contrast, Z-Fe3O4 consisted of irregular polygonal and spherical particles with diameters of 12–18 nm. Increasing the NaOH dosage promoted particle elongation, whereas shorter reaction times and higher temperatures suppressed rod formation. F-Fe3O4 exhibited a discontinuity near 270 K, attributed to the Verwey transition, and a saturation magnetization of 54.2 emu g-1,compared with 106.3 emu g-1 for Z-Fe3O4. After silica coating, the saturation magnetization of F-Fe3O4@SiO2 was 20.39 emu g-1. In a flowing-water model under an external magnetic field, the retention rates of F-Fe3O4, Z-Fe3O4, and F-Fe3O4@SiO2 were 68.43%, 66.09%, and 52.18%, respectively. These results establish a relationship between magnetic-field-assisted morphology evolution, magnetic properties, and magnetic retention under flow.

title: QBM: A Quantum Bayesian Machine for Relaxed Energy Prediction on Metal-Oxide Electrocatalysts
title_zh: QBM：用于金属氧化物电催化剂宽松能量预测的量子贝叶斯机
summary: 从氧化物催化剂的初始结构预测其弛豫总能量可以减少筛选所需的密度泛函理论弛豫次数。我们使用 Open Catalyst 2022 基准测试来检查固定描述符代理中模拟量子电路的三个角色：提出特征子集、定义保真度内核和学习残差校正。在报告的 16 个分量比较中，量子近似优化算法提出了一个需要 333 个子集拟合的池，而枚举需要 65,535 个子集拟合。验证错误在匹配的拟合中在域内上升并在域外下降。
abstract: Predicting the relaxed total energy of an oxide catalyst from its initial structure can reduce the number of density-functional-theory relaxations needed for screening. We use the Open Catalyst 2022 benchmark to examine three roles for simulated quantum circuits in a fixed-descriptor surrogate: proposing feature subsets, defining a fidelity kernel and learning a residual correction. In the reported 16-component comparison, the quantum approximate optimisation algorithm proposed a pool that required 333 subset fits, compared with 65,535 for enumeration. Validation error rose in domain and fell out of domain in the matched fit. Across six seed-paired fits, a validation-selected fidelity kernel reduced in-domain mean absolute error by a median of 4.33 meV per atom relative to linear ridge regression, with no median improvement out of domain. A trainable re-uploading circuit reduced in-domain error relative to ridge by a median of 1.28 meV per atom across five paired fits, with overlapping seed ranges. Under ideal CPU simulation, the clearest effect was subset pruning.

title: When Quantum Characterization Is Sufficient for a Decision
title_zh: 当量子表征足以做出决策时
summary: 量子表征充当量子硬件与校准、编译、验证和缓解量子硬件的软件之间的信息接口。然而，记录可以是任意精确的，并且仍然忽略控制下游决策的坐标。我们制定决策完整性：当 ker C 包含在 ker A 中时，特征图 C 准确地确定局部决策图 A。该标准是免重构的，并识别声明的局部模型内的最小任务导向增强。对于量子位编织重写，其数据兼容光纤上的平均保真度和单一性是恒定的，而首选电路则相反；因此，这些记录携带的有关该光纤上每个先前支持的决策的相互信息恰好为零。
abstract: Quantum characterization serves as the information interface between quantum hardware and the software that calibrates, compiles, verifies, and mitigates it. Yet a record can be arbitrarily precise and still omit the coordinate that controls a downstream decision. We formulate decision completeness: a characterization map C determines a local decision map A exactly when ker C is contained in ker A. This criterion is reconstruction-free and identifies the minimal task-directed augmentation within the declared local model. For a qubit braid rewrite, average fidelity and unitarity are constant on their data-compatible fiber while the preferred circuit reverses; these records therefore carry exactly zero mutual information about the decision for every prior supported on that fiber. A finite-error rule certifies left, certifies right, or abstains. On two public time-resolved gate-set-tomography acquisitions, the model is fitted separately to the first temporal half of each acquisition, while a selection threshold chosen on the first acquisition is transferred unchanged to the second. The resulting selector reaches 93.7% accuracy on 79 decidable pairs, versus 72.2% for the same-subset majority. On 151 fixed pairs, increasing characterization depth raises accuracy from 29.1% to 90.1%. Negative cross-date, cross-model, and software tests delimit transportability. In a separate audit of 14 public hardware-trained open-evolution models, 654 of 773 correlated rewrite targets reverse within the lower-fit-error half, excluding a condition-independent lookup rule in that modeled family. Expanding a generic probe from 7 to 15 settings reaches full training rank but does not improve held-out ranking. Characterization is thus complete only relative to the decisions it must support.

title: Rock Typing in the Digital Age: A Systematic Review of Petrophysical Foundations, Advanced Conventional Formulations, and the Ascent of Physics-Informed Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: 数字时代的岩石分型：对岩石物理基础、先进传统公式和基于物理的人工智能的发展进行系统回顾
summary: 岩石物理岩石分类 (PRT) 是储层表征、连接微观孔喉形态和宏观动态流动行为以控制碳氢化合物地质储量估计、饱和度高度函数和数值模拟网格块特性的基石。五十多年来，油藏工作流程一直依赖于毛细管压力曲线（Leverett，1941；Thomeer，1960）、孔喉尺寸校准（Winland R₃₅；Pittman，1992）和改进的Kozeny-Carman公式的传统框架，最引人注目的是Amaefule等人提出的油藏质量指数（RQI）和流动区指标（FZI）。 （1993）。
abstract: Petrophysical rock typing (PRT) is the cornerstone of reservoir characterization, bridging microscopic pore-throat morphology and macroscopic dynamic flow behavior to control hydrocarbon-in-place estimates, saturation–height functions, and numerical simulation grid-block properties. For over five decades, reservoir workflows have relied on conventional frameworks rooted in capillary pressure curves (Leverett, 1941; Thomeer, 1960), pore-throat size calibrations (Winland R₃₅; Pittman, 1992), and the modified Kozeny-Carman formulation, most notably the Reservoir Quality Index (RQI) and Flow Zone Indicator (FZI) proposed by Amaefule et al. (1993). However, these classical formulations frequently struggle in complex carbonate systems, tight gas sandstones, and multi-modal reservoirs due to fundamental physical limitations, including the conflation of static capillary storage with dynamic flow capacity, non-Darcy flow regimes, and unresolved multi-scale heterogeneity. This review systematically traces the methodological evolution of rock typing from its historical foundations to the contemporary ascent of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). We first evaluate advanced conventional advancements that address classical shortcomings, including the rigorous decoupling of Petrophysical Static Rock Types (PSRT) from Petrophysical Dynamic Rock Types (PDRT), the calibration of effective flow porosity (PHIZ) via Purcell-PSKT porosimetry, and fractal bound-water models for low-permeability rocks. We then conduct an in-depth critical analysis of data-driven AI, examining how unsupervised clustering (Self-Organizing Maps, K-Means, Fuzzy C-Means, DBSCAN) automates electrofacies discovery from multi-well wireline logs, and how supervised tree-based ensembles (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM) and deep architectures predict rock classes and continuous permeability. Crucially, we highlight the paradigm shift toward Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML), where non-Darcy flow physics and mass conservation are embedded directly into loss functions, and Explainable AI (SHAP, LIME) is leveraged to eliminate black-box opacity. We further analyze the revolution in Digital Rock Physics (DRP) and Image-based Microscale Rock Typing (IMRT), which combines micro-CT, FIB-SEM, and deep learning segmentation (PRRT and TSRT) with Lattice Boltzmann flow simulation to provide verifiable ground truth. Finally, we replace speculative risks with an industry-grounded audit of genuine operational pitfalls in AI petrophysics — including spatial autocorrelation data leakage, out-of-distribution extrapolation failure, core-to-log depth-matching errors, and regulatory compliance — and synthesize these insights into a unified, multi-scale, physics-informed digital rock typing roadmap for resilient reservoir modeling.
